about: Platform limits flowx-route checks a suggested pattern against (Azure Databricks docs, the target of an ADF migration). Data, not code. Every row names its source page and the date it was read; limits change, so check the page live before recommending; when a value has changed, use the live value and record it with its page and the date in the plan's conversation. Whoever re-verifies a row for flowx updates its value, page_date and read_on. 'fixed' is the docs' own Fixed column: 'no' means the account team can raise it, 'not stated' means the page doesn't say.

limits.limit: Tables per ingestion pipeline (recommended)
limits.quote: Databricks recommends ingesting 250 or fewer tables per pipeline.

limits.limit: Gateways per ingestion pipeline (a gateway can't be shared)
limits.quote: Each ingestion pipeline must be associated with exactly one ingestion gateway. Gateways cannot be shared across pipelines.

limits.limit: Compute the gateway runs on
limits.quote: Although the ingestion pipeline runs on serverless compute, the ingestion gateway must run on classic compute.

limits.limit: Tables per integrated CDC pipeline (recommended)
limits.quote: Recommended maximum of 300 tables per pipeline.

limits.limit: Minimum run of each extraction stage
limits.quote: each extraction stage runs for at least 10 minutes

limits.limit: Workspace must have integrated CDC enabled by the account team
limits.quote: Your workspace must have the integrated CDC connector feature enabled. Contact your Azure Databricks account team.

limits.limit: Tables with the same name in one pipeline, even from different schemas or databases
limits.quote: Databricks can't ingest two or more tables with the same name in the same pipeline, even if they come from different source schemas.

limits.limit: A source table whose name matches an existing destination table fails the update
limits.quote: If a source table name conflicts with an existing destination table name, the pipeline update fails.

limits.limit: Source must be a primary instance (no read replicas or secondaries)
limits.quote: Support is limited to primary SQL Server instances.

limits.limit: Tables per pipeline
limits.quote: Lakeflow pipelines Number of tables per pipeline 1,000 Pipeline Yes

limits.limit: Saved pipelines
limits.quote: Lakeflow pipelines Saved pipelines 12,000 Workspace Yes

limits.limit: Concurrent pipeline updates
limits.quote: Lakeflow pipelines Concurrent pipeline updates 1,000 Workspace Yes

limits.limit: Concurrent iterations of a pipeline task inside a For each task
limits.quote: A pipeline task wrapped in a for-each task is capped to one concurrent iteration, regardless of the loop's configured concurrency.

limits.limit: Tables per metastore
limits.quote: Unity Catalog Table 1,000,000 Metastore Yes

limits.limit: Tables per schema
limits.quote: Unity Catalog Table 10,000 Schema No

limits.limit: Schemas per catalog
limits.quote: Unity Catalog Schema 10,000 Catalog No

limits.limit: Catalogs per metastore
limits.quote: Unity Catalog Catalog 1,000 Metastore No

limits.limit: Volumes per metastore (each ingestion pipeline stages into a volume)
limits.quote: Unity Catalog Volume 100,000 Metastore No

limits.limit: Volumes per schema
limits.quote: Unity Catalog Volume 10,000 Schema No

limits.limit: Connections per metastore (a connection names one server)
limits.quote: Unity Catalog Connection 1,000 Metastore No

limits.limit: Metastores per region
limits.quote: You can create only one metastore per region.

limits.limit: Tasks running at once (Run job and For each parents not counted)
limits.quote: Jobs Tasks running simultaneously 2,000 Workspace Yes

limits.limit: Run job and For each parent tasks running at once
limits.quote: Jobs Parent tasks running simultaneously 750 Workspace Yes

limits.limit: Saved jobs
limits.quote: Jobs Saved jobs 12,000 Workspace Yes

limits.limit: For each inputs passed through task values (5,000 characters inline, 10,000 through a job parameter)
limits.quote: Parameters are limited to 5,000 characters in the UI directly, or 48 KB if you use task value references

limits.limit: NCC private endpoints per region, across 1 to 10 NCCs
limits.quote: Each region can have 100 private endpoints, distributed as needed across 1-10 NCCs.

limits.limit: Virtual machines per subscription per region (classic compute, gateways included)
limits.quote: Virtual machines Maximum 25,000 Per subscription per region Yes

unconfirmed.claim: Each Lakeflow Connect destination table is written by exactly one pipeline, so many sources can't write into one shared target table; a UNION ALL view across per-source tables is the usual workaround.
unconfirmed.why: Not found on the public Lakeflow Connect FAQ or the pipeline limitations page. Confirm with the account team before ruling a pattern out on it.

unconfirmed.claim: The release state of integrated CDC for SQL Server.
unconfirmed.why: The public page shows no release label (its continuous mode is marked Beta). Check the page live and state what it says before recommending it.

unconfirmed.claim: A running SQL Server ingestion gateway holds one of the workspace's concurrent pipeline updates for as long as it runs.
unconfirmed.why: Neither the SQL Server limits page nor the resource limits page says whether a gateway counts against the concurrent-update limit. Treat it as counting when sizing gateway mode, and confirm with the account team.
